Package Domain.Controllers

Interface IEnquestaCtrl

All Known Implementing Classes:
EnquestaCtrlLocalPersistence, EnquestaCtrlNoDB
public interface IEnquestaCtrl
Interface defining operations for managing Enquesta instances. Implementations of this interface handle the persistence, retrieval, and deletion of Enquesta objects.
